bootstrap.claim: blocks preserve within-week dependence and cross-asset common shocks; HMM emission refit uncertainty is not included
bootstrap.hmm_uncertainty_scope: fixed fitted emissions with Viterbi decoded-state transition/count re-estimation

identified_from_klines: return location/scale and empirical innovation quantiles
four-state Gaussian HMM occupancy, emissions, and transition matrix
jump frequency/scale/tail-index and post-jump volatility proxy
quote-volume, trade-count, and high-low-range activity proxies
not_identified_from_klines: latent fundamental value and fundamental-price coupling
bid-ask spread, queue priority, fill probability, and order-book depth
causal counterfactual impact of the benchmark focal agent

local_projection.claim: reduced-form cumulative response; not structural causal market impact

simulator_indirect_mapping.mapping: least-squares match of simulator geometric cumulative impulse curve

regime_model.claim: probabilistic statistical regimes; semantic labels are post-fit alignments, not uniquely identified economic market states
regime_model.transition_estimator: Viterbi decoded within-UTC-day transition frequencies on the complete synchronized blocks used by the bootstrap

quality_control.gap_policy: do not interpolate; discard irregular-duration bar and any incomplete aggregation block
